title.ja: L字領域P1特異解：graded格子と歪みの分離
title.en: L-corner P1 FEM: grading and separate mesh distortion

summary.ja: 再入隅の調和特異解を真の2D P1で解き、同じ未知数の一様/graded格子と、独立した滑らかな正方形の歪みを比較します。
summary.en: Solve a harmonic reentrant-corner field with actual2D P1 FEM; compare matched-DOF uniform/grading and separate smooth-square mesh distortion.

assumptions.ja: 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。
assumptions.en: L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids.

algorithm.ja: 面積と物理勾配からP1剛性を組み、境界を消去して疎直接法で解きます。隅要素は原点をDuffy写像の頂点に移し、Gauss48/96を比較。
algorithm.en: Assemble physical P1 gradients/areas, eliminate boundary data and solve sparse systems. Corner triangles use origin-based Duffy quadrature48/96.

validation.ja: L2/H1積分誤差・求積差、一様/gradedの同DOF改善、別のsquare/warped系列、最小角・aspect・1ノルム条件数推定・真の線形残差を保存。
validation.en: Retain integrated L2/H1 errors, quadrature gaps, matched-DOF grading improvement, separate square/warp errors, minimum angle/aspect, estimated1-norm conditioning and true residuals.

limits.ja: 特異解に正方形のL2二次を要求しません。固定の事前graded写像でありAMRソフトではありません。条件数は推定で、任意歪みへの保証はしません。
limits.en: No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified.

title.ja: 環状領域の可変粘性・真2DベクトルMMS

summary.ja: 軸を除く円環で可変粘性の応力発散方程式を実際に解き、速度・歪み・境界tractionと仕事を照合します。
summary.en: Actually solve variable-viscosity stress divergence on an annulus; check velocity, strain, physical traction and work.

assumptions.en: 1≤r≤2, periodic angle, mu=1+.2r², lambda0 and zero velocity on both circles. A(s)=(s−1)(4−s), u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2). Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr.

algorithm.ja: polarのmapped Q1にCartesian速度2成分を置き、r dr dthetaで2mu epsilonの弱形式を4×4 Gauss積分してblock疎解法。円周faceにはr dthetaと外向き法線を使う。
algorithm.en: Mapped polar Q1 with two Cartesian velocity components;4×4 Gauss integration of2mu epsilon uses exact r dr dtheta metric, followed by a block sparse solve. Circular traction uses r dtheta and outward normals.

validation.ja: 独自解析外力を別のCartesian応力差分で資格確認。L2速度/歪み/traction細分化、反力/体積外力と物理tractionの収支、粘性散逸と外力仕事を別々に測定。 体積外力の解析積分(756pi/5,0)も別に照合。
validation.en: Qualify the derived force by separate Cartesian stress differentiation. Measure velocity/strain/traction refinement, reactions versus volume-force/physical traction budgets, and viscous dissipation versus force work. Also check the independently integrated body force (756pi/5,0).

limits.ja: 線形vector粘性BVPです。divfree拘束・圧力・非線形Navier–Stokesは含めません。原点なしのr>0であり、軸stencil検証ではありません。
limits.en: A linear vector viscous BVP, without divergence-free constraint, pressure or nonlinear Navier–Stokes. r>0 only; no axis stencil certification.

title.ja: 純Neumannの互換条件と平均値ゲージ
title.en: Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge

summary.ja: 特異な2D Poissonを互換条件と指定平均込みで解き、不適合な外力を拒否します。
summary.en: Solve singular2D Poisson with compatibility/gauge and reject incompatible source.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形N16/32/64、セル中心の点DOF。cos(2pi x)cos(2pi y)、全壁Neumann0、平均0とN32の平均.25診断。
assumptions.en: Unit square N16/32/64, cell-centred point DOFs, cosine exact field, homogeneous Neumann; mean0 andN32 mean.25 probe.

algorithm.ja: 共有面差分で特異行列を組み、体積重み平均のLagrange拘束付き疎直接法とcompatible CGを照合。物理的な不適合外力の平均を勝手に引かない。
algorithm.en: Shared-face differences, weighted-mean augmented solve and compatible CG comparison; no physical RHS mean projection.

validation.ja: L2細分化、零空間、平均、CG差、source+1拒否、境界流束/体積源の収支を保存。
validation.en: Retain L2 refinement, nullspace/gauge/CG gap, source+1 rejection and boundary/source budget.

limits.ja: 同じ半離散系の別線形解法は独立PDE参照ではありません。既存Dirichlet MGの成功や2D任意境界へ一般化しません。
limits.en: A different linear solver of the same matrix is not an independent PDE discretization; no general boundary/MG claim.

title.en: 2D mixed Robin MMS and boundary flux

summary.ja: 2D PoissonのNeumann/Robin面を実際に組み、連続製造解と境界fluxを照合します。
summary.en: Assemble actual2D Neumann/Robin faces and compare the manufactured field and boundary flux.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形N16/32/64、u=cos(pi x)cos(2pi y)+x+y。x壁Neumann±1、y壁alpha1,beta.5の解析Robin。
assumptions.en: Unit square N16/32/64; cosine-plus-linear exact field. x walls Neumann±1; y walls analytic Robin alpha1,beta.5.

algorithm.ja: 半セル距離を用いてRobin境界値を消去し、外向きgradientの面積積分を離散式と同じ重みで評価。
algorithm.en: Eliminate Robin trace at half-cell distance, using the same outward-gradient face weights in the discrete PDE and budget.

validation.ja: 2D解/誤差、真の残差、Robin関係残差と解析法線flux誤差、3格子細分化と積分収支を保存。
validation.en: Save2D solution/errors, true residuals, Robin relation and analytic normal-flux errors, three-grid refinement and integral budget.

limits.ja: Robin問題は一意なので平均ゲージを重ねません。境界条件の代数残差と物理flux精度を区別します。
limits.en: The unique Robin problem has no additional mean gauge. Algebraic boundary satisfaction differs from physical flux accuracy.
